_comment: Zone-by-day route calendar (Tom, factory mapping v3, approved 2026-07-22). Lets 'מחר' resolve the zone automatically. Keys are weekday names to avoid index-convention bugs. null = no route day. Editable source of truth — update here if the weekly map changes.
next_working_day_rule: A dispatch date of Friday or Saturday is invalid; 'מחר' said on Thursday/Friday/Saturday resolves to Sunday.
